## Section 4 -- T5 Closed Items

| ID | Item | Priority | Source | Status |
|----|------|----------|--------|--------|
| DW-B20-CHARTTRADER-01 | Eliminate ChartTrader Buy/Sell/Close button blockage (ATR overlay row-0 overlap). Root cause was `BuildAtrOverlayRow` injecting a `Border` into `chartTraderRoot.Children` with no `Grid.SetRow` call (defaults to row 0), overlapping native NT8 buttons. Purge-loop gap allowed accumulation across F5 cycles. Fix: delete `BuildAtrOverlayRow`, `ResolveChartTraderPanel`, `_atrOverlayLabel` from AddOn; move ATR display label to `TradeCopierPanel.BuildRiskAtrRow` (panel-owned, purge-safe). Update `UpdateAtrOverlay` to route through `_panels` registry via `panel.SetAtrText`. | P1 | B20-LANE-C T5 (DW-B20-CHARTTRADER-01) | **CLOSED (T5)** |

**New deferred items introduced by T5**: NONE. T5 is a structural fix. The root cause (wrong ownership layer) is fully resolved. No residual technical debt introduced.
